ideas.title: Uncovering Childcare Scams
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of childcare scams in the US, and the measures being taken to prevent them.
questions: What is the total amount of money stolen in childcare scams?
What are the most common methods used to commit childcare scams?
ideas.insight: Childcare scams are a growing concern, with millions of dollars being stolen. By analyzing data and following the money, we can uncover the extent of these scams and identify patterns to prevent future cases.
